parse.title: In Search of Knowledge/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
==Walkthrough==
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Brother Aimeri]] in the southern part of the [[Forthos Dungeon]] (by the entrance to [[Sarachnis]]).
**Quick travel there includes: [[Watson teleport]] scroll, [[Xeric's Talisman]] to Xeric's Glade, [[Kourend Castle Teleport]] and [[skills necklace]] to the [[Woodcutting Guild]].
*Use all 5 pieces of your food on him.
*Talk to [[Brother Aimeri]] again, and ask who are you to start the miniquest. {{Chat option|2}}
*Protect from Magic and then run west through the long hallway to the room with [[Undead Druid]]s.
*Search the [[musty bookshelf|bookshelves]] until you have all three tomes:
**[[Tome of the moon]]
**[[Tome of the sun]]
**[[Tome of the temple]]
* Collect 4 of each [[tattered sun page|tattered sun]], [[tattered moon page|moon]] and [[tattered temple page|temple page]] by killing any monsters in the [[Forthos Dungeon]]. Put them in the corresponding tomes.
**One suggested strategy that is fast, and somewhat AFKable, is to kill [[Temple spiders]] using multi-hit [[Ancient Magicks]] or a fast weapon, such as the [[Toxic Blowpipe]], with [[Protect from Melee]] activated making sure to [[Tolerance|reset aggression]] every 10 minutes.
*Go to the [[Arceuus Library]]
*Use the tomes on [[Logosia]]
*'''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''}}
